knowledgeAnswers.rationale: One agreed zone at a time keeps keepsakes, waste and the plan separate.
Undecided items stay in the undecided zone until the resident gives a decision.
The plan's limit and controls apply. A box beyond them is left and recorded, not forced.

practicalCriteria: In a training zone drawing, the learner sets a boundary and an order of work for one room and labels four categories.
The learner reconciles a mock daily inventory with a mock decision log and records one change.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Items are moved beyond the plan's lifting limit.
